remarks:
A True Lake Ontario Estate: 3+ Acres of Turnkey Waterfront Luxury! Rare opportunity to own a private, 3.04-acre lakefront oasis boasting 160 feet of direct shoreline on Lake Ontario with breathtaking, year-round sunset views and a clear sightline to the Toronto skyline. Situated in the prestigious, top-rated Lewiston-Porter School District, this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom split-colonial blends unmatched privacy with complete mechanical peace of mind.
Over $190,000 in capital improvements have been meticulously completed over the last six years, leaving absolutely zero deferred maintenance. Structural and exterior updates include a brand-new roof across the house and detached garage/studio (2025), a massive newly reconstructed driveway ($27,000) with fresh concrete work ($12,000), premium some Stanek windows ($20,000), and new gutter guards.
The utility infrastructure has been completely modernized, featuring a newly run natural gas line brought directly from the road ($5,200), dual new furnaces and A/C units and minny split heat pump for studio over detached garage ($40,000), a whole-house 20KW backup generator ($8,500), and a Culligan Reverse Osmosis system.
Inside, enjoy a spacious, light-filled layout featuring hardwood floors, fresh carpeting, Florida/sunroom, cozy fireplaces, and heated flooring sections. The expansive grounds feature a sprawling detached outer 3 bay garage with 2nd flr studio, newly optimized with a custom loft with Heat, A/C & WIFI ($12,000) perfect for a hobbyist, workshop, or studio. End your days relaxing in the private hot tub overlooking your massive, park-like acreage. Truly a rare, estate-scale waterfront where all the heavy lifting has already been done for you. Seller reserves ability to set date for negotiations.
